## Class Questions

> - What do you want to talk about today?

## Basic Concepts

> - What is emotional labor? Who does it — is it only certain jobs, or is it present in most work?
> - What is the difference between surface acting and deep acting? Which is more costly, and why?
> - Where does emotional labor show up in organizations you've been part of?

## Basic Concepts (cont.)

> - What is burnout? What are its organizational (not just individual) causes?
> - What are organizational norms around emotion — what emotions are "allowed" at work, and what gets suppressed? Who gets to set those norms?
> - How do those norms vary by industry, role, or identity?

## Basic Concepts (cont.)

> - What is emotional intelligence in an organizational context? Is it a skill, a trait, or something else?
> - Is it possible to have too much emotional intelligence, or to misuse it? What would that look like?
> - What would an organization that takes emotional labor seriously actually do differently?
